name: developer-set
description: Subagents for the delivery pipeline: project management, architecture, development, SRE, AI reliability, QC and QA.

output_language.title: Output language
output_language.description: Language the agents reply in: auto (same as your input), en, ja, or any BCP-47 code such as fr or zh-CN. Translation agents always output in the requested target language.

allow_concurrency.title: Allow concurrency
allow_concurrency.description: Let the sprint-plan, design-review and release-check commands run independent agent steps at the same time. Off by default: steps run one at a time, in order. You can also pass --parallel or --sequential to a single run.
